tasks.ask: In sf_ops.incidents, count records of kind machine_overheat grouped by false_alarm and shift_code for Jul-Oct 2026, including sum of downtime_min and cars_lost.
In sf_plant.machine_telemetry, count hourly readings where heat_dissipation_failure=1 grouped by machine_id for Jul-Oct 2026, with total readings per machine.

Join sf_ops.incidents of kind machine_overheat to sf_plant.machine_telemetry on machine_id and date_trunc HOUR of ts; count incidents whose matched telemetry shows heat_dissipation_failure=1 versus 0 or no match.
Join sf_ops.incidents of kind machine_overheat to sf_plant.weather_hourly on the incident hour; compare average outdoor_temp_c of overheat incidents to average outdoor_temp_c of all incident kinds.
